requestCanonicalEnvelope.dependencies: sorted already admitted receipt digests, no self-reference
requestCanonicalEnvelope.policySources: sorted exact canonical source/whole-file digest/actual decision refs

contentRevision: sha256:<lowercase SHA256 canonical request envelope>; canonical bytes and SQL projections exactly inherited from source-provenance-format.json/md
requestDependencies: No additional interface key. For this closed independent policy qualification dependencies is exactly []; missing authority cannot be substituted by empty dependencies. The full movement request later carries returned receiptDigest.
requiredBindings: exact actual resolved reset event from inf.rait_case_event OR inf.infraction_event
supportBindings: All actual support/audit rows named by independently admitted proof; no unrelated extras, duplicates or competing unresolved reset events. Existing per-table fieldsets unchanged.
policySourceSelection: Nonempty actual complete applicable C policy subset of existing fixed canonical sources, including WF-RAIT-002#4.2 and its verified actual decision provenance. No invented decisionRef; independently validate completeness/legal applicability, not merely subset membership.
receipt: Existing rait-risk-receipt-v1 core, kind movement, actual tenant/case, full exact bindings, independently verified historical authorization, dependencies=[], exact nonempty applicable policySources. No new receipt kind/namespace/store/writer. Reader method purpose plus complete policySources and binding validation distinguishes policy use; kind movement alone never qualifies policy.
receiptDigest: SHA256 of independently retrieved/admitted full existing canonical receipt core, not contentRevision or opaque sourceVersions. Validate digest and origin, bindings and current SQL independently.
failure: Absent optional method, unknown purpose, malformed/extra keys, missing/ambiguous receipt, bad digest, wrong parent/tenant/clock/timer/event, incomplete/unknown/conflicting policy => RAIT.RISK_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE503 before effects
production: qualifyPolicy absent OR explicit missing; no accepted production policy verifier invented
fullMovement: Existing full movement qualification still binds actual source rows and returned receiptDigest as independently retrieved verified dependency; include opaque policy versions as versions only. Never decode rrv1, never qualify movement with empty refs.
fixture: Pre-admit immutable synthetic complete policy receipts independently before HTTP. Reader re-reads actual SQL rows, verifies full policy/source/decision bindings and recomputes canonical request; no request echo. Fixture opaque IDs deliberately differ from receiptDigest.
authorizationLockSequence: R7 ordered global relation locks and parent locks
same-Tx locked S1 assertCase/revalidation before source disclosure; revocation denies
